Guidance on corporate responsibility indicators in annual reports

The purpose of this guidance is to assist preparers of enterprise reporting in producing concise and comparable corporate responsibility indicators within their annual financial reports. Among the guiding principles discussed are three key dimensions: (a) the development dimension; (b) performance orientation; and (c) a focus on national reporting. This document provides a concise overview of the selected indicators along with detailed guidance on reporting each of the selected indicators, organised around the following: background; definitions; compilation; and presentation and disclosure
